name: video-ad-stack
title_zh: 从品牌调研到出片一条龙，中途每一步都给你改
tagline_zh: 做广告视频最怕方向错了白干。这个 Skill 从品牌调研、参考片拆解到可编辑的广告方案。
tagline_en: Stop wasting renders on wrong directions. This skill walks you from brand research and reference breakdown to an.
desc_en: Guide the user from brand research and reference video analysis through an editable ad plan to Higgsfield video generation. Use when the user says start the video ad stack, run the video ad stack, or asks for this guided product-ad workflow.
why_zh: 不是黑盒一键生成，而是把广告制作拆成可干预的关卡。每过一关都产出可编辑的中间物，你随时能叫停改方向。
why_en: Not a black-box generator. Each stage yields an editable artifact, so you can redirect the campaign before pixels get burned on.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Higgsfield 视频生成，不接其他视频工具；需要你提供品牌基础资料，否则调研环节会卡住。
limit_en: Outputs only via Higgsfield; needs your brand basics or research stalls; bring your own reference video links—it won't source them.
title_en: Guided ad workflow: brand research to Higgsfield video.
